name: 8 · Lunar Greenhouse
rule_text: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover.

levels.title: 8-01 · One Small Plant
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. Establish economy and cover all five lanes.
levels.joke: The welcome mat says hello, not all-you-can-eat. The greenhouse airlock is not an all-you-can-eat entrance. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.

levels.title: 8-02 · Sun Has Roaming Charges
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. Build sun production before doubling your shooters.
levels.joke: Sunlight remains free. The zombie subscription is harder to cancel. Gravity has submitted a flexible-working request. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 8-03 · Astronaut Internship
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Local traffic cone promoted to middle management. The lunar landlord wants the crater back by Monday. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 8-04 · Gravity Is Optional
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: The doctor recommends more brains. Seek a second opinion. Space is silent; the seed packet is loudly disappointed. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 8-05 · Audit of Reality
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Your delivery is three lanes away and marked delivered. Mission control has replied with a gardening emoji. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.

levels.title: 8-06 · Roots in a Vacuum
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. Lose no more than 3 plants to attacks or shoveling. Single-use plants do not count.
levels.joke: The roots have formed a union. Please keep them alive. Gravity has submitted a flexible-working request. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 8-07 · Mowers Cannot Breathe
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. No mowers. Any breach fails the mission.
levels.joke: The mowers have requested a mental-health day. Mission control has replied with a gardening emoji. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 8-08 · The Enlightened Detour
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Turn signals are apparently a living-person feature. The lunar landlord wants the crater back by Monday. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 8-09 · Orbital Solar Reserve
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. Hold 4500 unspent sun and clear all waves. Collection continues after the last zombie. The accountant also forbids losing more than 8 plants.
levels.joke: Four thousand sun in savings. Still cannot afford a garden shed. Space is silent; the seed packet is loudly disappointed. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 8-10 · Nineteen Lunar Licenses
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. Win with at most 19 planting actions, including grafts and rafts. Bonus clause: lose no more than 6 plants.
levels.joke: Twenty plants. Infinite unsolicited gardening opinions. The greenhouse airlock is not an all-you-can-eat entrance. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 8-11 · Interns in Orbit
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. Clear the fast waves within 380 seconds. Speed is not an excuse: lose no more than 10 plants.
levels.joke: An internship with excellent exposure and no pulse. The greenhouse airlock is not an all-you-can-eat entrance. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.

levels.title: 8-12 · Four Cosmic Casualties
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. Lose no more than 4 plants. Transformations and deliberate single-use plants are exempt.
levels.joke: Five losses are a tragedy. Six are a failed level. Space is silent; the seed packet is loudly disappointed. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 8-13 · Space Food Selection
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. The supplied seed menu is fixed. Supplies are borrowed even if not yet unlocked.
levels.joke: The chef insists the menu is a tactical constraint. The lunar landlord wants the crater back by Monday.

levels.title: 8-14 · Moon Craters Need Permits
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. Dark crossed tiles cannot be planted. Zombies still travel through them.
levels.joke: These tiles are reserved for a future parking lot. Gravity has submitted a flexible-working request. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 8-15 · Zero-Gravity Grafting
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. Create at least 2 grafts and clear the waves. Same-plant twin hybrids count too.
levels.joke: Botany: now with legally questionable welding. Mission control has replied with a gardening emoji.

levels.title: 8-16 · Orbital Garden Cannon
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. No plants or seeds required. Click a board tile to fire a free recharging area cannon.
levels.joke: No plants today. The salad has authorized artillery. The greenhouse airlock is not an all-you-can-eat entrance.

levels.title: 8-17 · The Herald of Late Fees
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. Cover the specialist wave; avoid relying on a single front wall.
levels.joke: This wave has read the terms and conditions. You have not. Gravity has submitted a flexible-working request. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 8-18 · Bucket with Life Support
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. Armor soaks projectiles. Save explosives for tightly grouped helmets.
levels.joke: Buckets protect brains, not fragile workplace morale. Space is silent; the seed packet is loudly disappointed. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 8-19 · Eclipse Picnic
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. No sky sun. Start from the supplied savings and plant your own economy.
levels.joke: Solar power at night: accounting would like a word. The lunar landlord wants the crater back by Monday.

levels.title: 8-20 · Multiverse Staffing Crisis
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. Summoners and small runners require rear coverage, not just one front tank. No breaches: interns are not allowed indoors.
levels.joke: Fresh interns have arrived. Their onboarding is your problem. The lunar landlord wants the crater back by Monday. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 8-21 · Save the Last Greenhouse
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. No planting; lose no more than 5 plants. A mature garden is provided. Protect it; click a damaged plant for a free 1200-HP repair every 3 seconds. Crafted tools are optional.
levels.joke: The garden is already planted. Your job description says keep it that way. The greenhouse airlock is not an all-you-can-eat entrance.

levels.title: 8-22 · Five Thousand Stars
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. Collect a total of 5000 sun in this battle. Spending does not reduce this total.
levels.joke: Collect 4000 sun. Do not stare directly at the counter. Gravity has submitted a flexible-working request. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 8-23 · Seed Payload Limit
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. Fixed five-seed deck (graft two Pod Shooters into a Twin Pod for double fire) and a total limit of 26 planting actions.
levels.joke: The seeds were packed by a minimalist. Mission control has replied with a gardening emoji.

levels.title: 8-24 · The Three-Giant Summit
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. Long mixed assault. On the Moon, all three Gargantuans arrive in separate waves.
levels.joke: The committee has decided to attack simultaneously. Space is silent; the seed packet is loudly disappointed. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 8-25 · Final Notice: Get Off My Moon
levels.briefing: Gravity pulses shift an announced lane into the next lane. Use overlapping cover. Two giant arrivals with a rebuilding window. Counter its special ability, then clear the field.
levels.joke: The giant brought a club. The homeowners association brought a fine. Mission control has replied with a gardening emoji. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.
